summary: The shell has a route picker model, custom action items and route events for an app's own destinations. The routing controller does not discover or stream to real remote receivers, and there is no data channel.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: Route picker with local and discovered outputs
features.note: local outputs first, then discovered receivers; the local output switch is the only real route
an app is told when the user activates, deactivates or reactivates one of its destinations

features.feature: Custom action items in the picker
features.note: action items named by the app's configuration
the app-facing side of receiver discovery; no network discovery of real receivers
no playback session on a remote device and no data channel

gaps: No discovery or streaming to real remote receivers; the AirPlay-style sender is a gap.
No remote playback session or data channel.
